guard_pose: fighting stance facing right, fists raised

nspecial: flicks one open hand forward as if throwing a shard, then pulls it back
sspecial: slides forward low on one leg and kicks with the other, ending in a low crouch
uspecial: jumps straight up with her arms raised, her hair and coat streaming below her
dspecial: raises both palms in front of her face as a guard, then pushes them forward
ultimate: spreads her arms and floats slightly, her hair and coat rising around her, then lands in a stronger stance
